fee_notes: The standard Initial Franchise Fee is $49,500 for a territory with a population of 1,000,000 or more. Additional franchise licenses beyond the first are $40,000 each. Fees are paid in full as a lump sum at signing and are non-refundable, though the franchisor may negotiate the fee in certain circumstances (e.g., existing operators opening additional locations, taking over an operating business). A 25% veterans discount is available to honorably discharged veterans who own 51%+ of the franchised business, reducing the first franchise fee to approximately $37,125. Additional required purchases in Item 5 include: CAD Design Software Key ($3,400 per key, up to $10,200 for three); Opening Showroom Displays ($5,000–$32,000 total, with $0–$10,000 purchased from franchisor); BIZTRAX CRM Software Setup ($500, payable to franchisor).
raw_excerpt: The Initial Franchise Fee for a Closet & Storage Concepts franchise is Forty-Nine Thousand Five-hundred dollars ($49,500.00) for a territory having a population of 1,000,000 individuals or more. The Initial Franchise Fee for each Closet & Storage Concepts business beyond the first one is Forty Thousand dollars ($40,000.00). We offer qualified franchise candidates a 25% reduction in the Initial Franchise Fee for their first Franchised Business.
